headline: Reproducible, browser-based and pipeline tools for microbial genome, amplicon and tree analysis
label: Microbial Genomics Workflow Tooling
summary: New tools span phylogenetic viewing, 16S profiling, genome alignment and annotation QC, alongside MGnify v6's automated, programmatically accessible analyses.
synthesis: The common thread is packaging microbial genomics analyses into accessible, reproducible tooling. For 16S data, RADSuite pairs RADlib, a curated gene copy database, with RADx for identifying variable regions toward species-level resolution, and VPHYL converts Emu and EPI2ME wf-16s nanopore tables into phyloseq or BIOM objects with HTML reports. Big Tree Viewer renders trees up to a million tips in the browser with agentic AI integration, and Sparrowhawk uses WebAssembly for local, private browser tools. nf-core/pairgenomealign wraps LAST pairwise whole-genome alignment in Nextflow, ABAQS scores genome annotation quality, and MGnify v6 adds amplicon variant analysis, expanded viral and mobilome annotation, and Nextflow/Prefect automation. Scopes differ, and the summaries report no cross-tool performance comparisons.
